Let \(f\) be the function given by \(f(x)=\frac{x^{3}}{4}-\frac{x^{2}}{3}-\frac{x}{2}+3 \cos x\). Let \(R\) be the shaded region in the second
quadrant bounded by the graph of \(f\), and let \(S\) be the shaded region bounded by the graph of \(f\) and line \(\ell\), the
line tangent to the graph of \(f\) at \(x=0\), as shown above.
(a) Find the area of \(R\).
(b) Find the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is rotated about the horizontal line \(y=-2\).
(c) Write, but do not evaluate, an integral expression that can be used to find the area of \(S\).
